policy.method: Adjust only the four consumers left without a confirmed operational path after 95, matching existing Dragon 6, Misunderstanding and Sudden Trip.

changed_cards.before: 1ターンに1回。自分がセカイを変更した時、自分になかまがある場合、発動できる。自分のなかま1枚を選ぶ。このターン、そのなかまが相手の効果で盤面を離れる場合、1回だけ盤面を離れない。
changed_cards.after: 1ターンに1回。自分がセカイを変更した時、自分になかまがある場合、発動できる。自分のなかま1枚を選ぶ。次の自分のターン開始時まで、そのなかまが相手の効果で盤面を離れる場合、1回だけ盤面を離れない。
changed_cards.change: Extend the already-applied protection through the next opponent turn; do not add a removal card.

changed_cards.before: 1ラウンドに1回。自分のセカイが相手の効果で捨て札に置かれるなら、手札のセカイ1枚を公開して捨て札に置くことで、セカイ枠のそのカードを捨て札に置かない。
changed_cards.after: 1ラウンドに1回。自分のセカイが相手の効果で手札または捨て札に移るなら、手札のセカイ1枚を公開して捨て札に置くことで、その移動を防いでもよい。
changed_cards.change: Keep the current world in play against the existing hand-return event as well as a future discard move.

changed_cards.before: このカードとの交際または結婚が終了し、このカードがこいびと枠から捨て札に置かれた時、自分のメインがたまごでない場合、捨て札で発動できる。山札上2枚を見て、その中から1枚を手札に加え、残りを山札の一番下に置く。
changed_cards.after: このカードが相手の効果でこいびと枠から手札または捨て札に移動し、このカードとの交際または結婚が終了した時、自分のメインがたまごでない場合、その移動先で発動できる。山札上2枚を見て、その中から1枚を手札に加え、残りを山札の一番下に置く。
changed_cards.change: Trigger after an opponent-caused breakup to hand or discard; preserve the breakup penalty and egg invalidation.

changed_cards.before: 自分のメイン1枚を対象として発動できる。このターン、そのメインが相手の効果で手札に戻るなら、1回だけ、代わりに場に残す。このターン、自分が次に手札からセカイを通常の方法で変更するための時を1少なくする。
changed_cards.after: 自分のメイン1枚を対象として発動できる。このターン、そのメインが相手の効果で捨て札に置かれるなら、1回だけ、代わりに場に残す。このターン、自分が次に手札からセカイを通常の方法で変更するための時を1少なくする。
changed_cards.change: Replace the unprovided main hand-return protection with discard protection that can resolve before Dragon 6.

connections.path: World change on B turn -> applied protection through next B start -> Dragon 6 on A turn -> companion remains once
Sudden Trip targets B world -> pay a different world from hand -> prevent return to hand
Misunderstanding moves Snowman from partner slot to hand -> relationship ends and -10 applies -> ability can activate in hand
Dragon 6 targets B main -> Highway Drive resolves first -> discard move is replaced by remaining in play

remaining_zero_supply: opponent companion field directly to hand without a replacement path
remaining_partial_consumers: C-sheep: direct companion to hand branch

manual_cases.input: Penguin 7 changes world with a companion present
manual_cases.expected: Choose one companion and apply one protection through the next own turn start.

manual_cases.input: After P01, opponent Dragon 6 targets the chosen companion
manual_cases.expected: The companion remains; Dragon costs remain paid.

manual_cases.input: After P02, a second opponent effect moves that companion
manual_cases.expected: The spent one-use protection does not prevent the second move.

manual_cases.input: No interference occurs before Penguin player's next start
manual_cases.expected: The protection expires before reactions at that start.

manual_cases.input: Chosen companion leaves through its controller's full-slot replacement
manual_cases.expected: No protection because the move is not caused by an opponent effect.

manual_cases.input: Penguin 7 leaves after the protection was applied
manual_cases.expected: The applied duration effect remains until its deadline.

manual_cases.input: Chosen companion returns by its controller's effect and is replayed
manual_cases.expected: The original object is not protected or tracked after leaving.

manual_cases.input: Penguin 7 changes world while its controller has no companion
manual_cases.expected: The ability cannot activate and does not protect a companion played later.

manual_cases.input: Sudden Trip targets a world controlled by Dandelion 4; another world is in hand
manual_cases.expected: Pay the hand world and prevent the return to hand.

manual_cases.input: D01 without a world card in hand
manual_cases.expected: The prevention cannot be applied; the field world returns to hand.

manual_cases.input: D01 with payment available but prevention declined
manual_cases.expected: The targeted world returns to hand.

manual_cases.input: Controller normally replaces their own world
manual_cases.expected: Dandelion 4 does not apply to the controller's basic move.

manual_cases.input: A hypothetical opponent effect moves the world to deck
manual_cases.expected: Outside the revised text; not counted as current supply.

manual_cases.input: Two qualifying moves occur in one round
manual_cases.expected: The same Dandelion 4 object can prevent only the first chosen move.

manual_cases.input: Misunderstanding targets Snowman while its controller has a non-egg main
manual_cases.expected: Snowman returns to hand, relationship ends, -10 applies, and the hand ability can activate.

manual_cases.input: S01 ability resolves while the main remains non-egg
manual_cases.expected: Look at two, add one to hand, put the other on deck bottom.

manual_cases.input: Love Letter prevents S01's return
manual_cases.expected: No move or relationship end, so Snowman does not activate.

manual_cases.input: Try to use Cactus's self-protection for Snowman
manual_cases.expected: Cannot apply another partner card's ability.

manual_cases.input: Controller is egg from the move through the first activation opportunity
manual_cases.expected: Snowman cannot activate and does not carry the trigger forward.

manual_cases.input: Snowman activates legally, then controller is egg when resolution begins
manual_cases.expected: The partner ability's effect is not applied; spent activation state remains.

manual_cases.input: Controller discards Snowman from hand as a cost
manual_cases.expected: No activation because it was not moved from the partner slot by an opponent effect.

manual_cases.input: A hypothetical opponent effect discards Snowman from the partner slot
manual_cases.expected: The text could activate in discard, but this hypothetical is not current supply.

manual_cases.input: Dragon 6 targets a main and Highway Drive is chained
manual_cases.expected: Highway resolves first and the main remains once when Dragon resolves.

manual_cases.input: H01 with only one time remaining
manual_cases.expected: Highway cannot be activated; Dragon removes the main absent another defense.

manual_cases.input: After H01, another discard removal targets the same main that turn
manual_cases.expected: The one-use protection is spent and does not prevent the second move.

manual_cases.input: A hypothetical effect returns the main to hand
manual_cases.expected: Outside the revised Highway protection and not counted as current supply.

manual_cases.input: Highway is used on its controller's turn before a normal world change
manual_cases.expected: The next normal change costs one less whether or not the protection is used.

manual_cases.input: Highway is used on the opponent's turn in response to Dragon
manual_cases.expected: The main can be protected, but the normal-world-change discount expires unused at turn end.

verification_scope: 28 manually reasoned local situations. No game engine, random matches, win-rate or reachability measurement.
